thread:
marta: quick RFC follow-up — I built a tiny observer-mode simulator to run autoscaler policy changes without touching prod. API + CLI. want feedback before I open a PR.
kevin: love it. does observer-mode mutate anything today?
sriniv: it should be read-only. design: snapshot intent graph + aggregated telemetry, run a mock allocator in-memory. no DB writes.
julia: pretty please include modeled node boot/driver warmup delays, otherwise we under-estimate tail latency.
marta: yep — simulator supports configurable boot/ready delays and preemptible behavior.
kevin: CI ask: can we run a deterministic sim on PRs and upload a compact diff artifact? avoid flaky stochastic runs in PRs.
ops-bot: +1 to that flow. suggest deterministic seed for PRs, stochastic nightly fuzz jobs for discovery.
infra-bot: infra notes: will need a snapshot pipeline (1h window, 1m bins) and a small job queue. estimate low infra work.
sriniv: next steps: marta will post design doc + toy impl. owners: marta, kevin, sriniv. I'll review the mock allocator code.
marta: thanks — I'll open the PR today and add a GH action that runs the sim and attaches results. :thumbsup:
